manifests.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=83", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "aspose-pdf-foss-for-python"
description = "Open-source Python library for PDF parsing, manipulation, validation, and extraction."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
license = "MIT"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
dynamic = ["version"]
authors = [
  { name = "Aspose Pty Ltd" },
]
keywords = ["pdf", "document", "text-extraction", "merge", "watermark"]
dependencies = [
  "cryptography>=50",
  "asn1crypto>=1.5",
]
classifiers = [
  "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
  "Intended Audience :: Developers",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
  "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",
  "Topic :: Text Processing",
  "Typing :: Typed",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Python"
Repository = "https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Python"
Issues = "https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Python/issues"
Changelog = "https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Python/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md"

[project.optional-dependencies]
images = [
  "Pillow>=12.3",
]
woff2 = [
  "Brotli>=1.2",
]
text-layout = [
  "uharfbuzz>=0.37",
  "python-bidi>=0.6",
  "fonttools>=4.60.2",
]
fuzz = [
  "atheris>=2.3",
]
dev = [
  "build>=1.2",
  "jsonschema>=4.18",
  "pytest>=8",
  "ruff>=0.6",
  "setuptools>=83",
  "twine>=5",
  "wheel",
  "Brotli>=1.2",
  "fonttools>=4.60.2",
  "Pillow>=12.3",
  "uharfbuzz>=0.37",
  "python-bidi>=0.6",
  "reportlab>=4.2",
]

[tool.setuptools]
include-package-data = true
package-dir = { "" = "src" }

[tool.setuptools.dynamic]
version = { attr = "aspose_pdf._version.__release_version__" }

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
aspose_pdf = ["py.typed"]
"aspose_pdf.engine.data" = [
  "cmaps/*.json.zlib",
  "cmaps/*.txt",
  "cmaps/README.md",
  "fonts/*.ttf.zlib",
  "fonts/LICENSE-OFL.txt",
  "fonts/LICENSE-DEJAVU.txt",
  "fonts/README.md",
  "agl/*.json.zlib",
  "agl/*.txt",
  "agl/README.md",
]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
include = ["aspose_pdf", "aspose_pdf.*"]
exclude = ["tests*", "build*", "dist*"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
python_files = ["test_*.py"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 88
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E4", "E7", "E9", "F", "I", "UP", "RUF"]
external = ["BLE", "S"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# The suite feeds the extractor real Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic and CJK text, so
# "ambiguous" characters in fixtures and the prose describing them are the
# point of the test rather than a typo.
"tests/*" = ["RUF001", "RUF002", "RUF003"]
